title: Enterprise security request stewardship and priority broker
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a 'stewardship and priority broker' for incoming enterprise security & compliance requests (vendor questionnaires, SOC2/ISO evidence asks, GDPR/DPA clarifications, HIPAA scoping) that converts raw intake into an actionable prioritized ticket with evidence bundles and SLA guidance. The broker should combine account risk signals (contract value, regulatory footprint), technical exposure (model types, data residency), and historical resolution times to recommend triage lanes: Automated Low-touch, Evidence Assemble, Escalate to Legal, or Dedicated SRE/Privacy path.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming requests from email/form/webhook are classified into one of four lanes with >= 90% precision on a 200-sample test set
System attaches a minimal evidence bundle template and estimated SLA to every triaged ticket within 30 minutes of intake
For high-risk requests (customer_impact=high or regulatory footprint present) automatic escalation to Legal and Security oncall is created with contextual links
Operators can override the lane and reclassify with an audit trail and reason logged
The broker emits metrics to the Console dashboard: per-lane throughput, average time-to-first-action, evidence completion rate
decision_log: 2025-02-18: Decided to use hybrid classifier (rule-based prefilters + LLM classifier for ambiguous cases) to balance precision and explainability
2025-02-20: Agreed on four triage lanes to limit cognitive load on operators; mapped lanes to existing org roles (SRE, Legal, Privacy, Evidence Collector)
2025-02-25: Chose initial SLA tiers: 72h (Low), 48h (Medium), 24h (High), 8h (Critical) based on contract SLAs and customer tiering

mitigation_strategies: Automated evidence bundler for low-risk requests to reduce manual labor
Escalation to Legal for contract or addendum asks
Temporary canned responses for frequent questionnaire items to accelerate first reply
Retention of audit trail for every reclassification and operator action
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Pilot): Ingest requests for 5 mid-market accounts; human-in-the-loop classification (Mar 2025)
Phase 1 (MVP): Expand to all self-serve and sales-sourced questionnaire intake; enable Auto Low-touch lane for <P1 accounts (Apr 2025)
Phase 2: Add SLA estimation tied to contract value and legal risk scoring; integrate with Console dashboards and alerting (May 2025)
Phase 3: Regionalization - data residency flags and local legal templates for EU/APAC (Q3 2025)
Rollout includes training docs, runbook for operators, and a closed beta cohort
risk_assessment_summary: Primary risks: classifier false negatives for high-risk asks (mitigated by rule-based prefilters and mandatory manual review for flagged accounts); SLA breaches during peak volume (mitigated with burst on-call and interim canned responses); cross-border legal nuance leading to incorrect evidence - will defer to Legal owner for final decisions.
notes: We must avoid over-automation for high-value enterprise accounts. For Bronze/Silver customers we can be more aggressive with automated evidence bundling.
Consider a future integration with Redwood Optimize to recommend quantization/model variants when customers ask about model residency/exposure
Schedule a post-mortem after pilot to capture false positive/negative patterns and update classifier prompts
